activity_summary: At the Split Hazel, before the play, Kemp told the hamper, the stool, the line and the glove, and Alice made him move his elbows before she allowed the end. You enjoyed it. Then, in the same voice, he asked whether the Queen's twenty pounds had come. You said it is expected. She said expected money has eaten several dinners in this house and never paid for one. Kemp laughed loudest and paid for his own. You paid fourpence, and you did not put the twenty pounds in your purse.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Enjoyed the story, said the twenty pounds are expected and not his, and paid fourpence.

entities.name: Alice Brambleby

entities.name: Will Kemp

facets.activity: Said the Queen's twenty pounds are expected, and paid fourpence

quotes.speaker: alice_brambleby
quotes.text: Expected money has eaten several dinners in this house, Master Shakespeare, and never paid for one.

quotes.speaker: will_kemp
quotes.text: I am the loudest man in the room, and I am paying for my own.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: This dinner is fourpence, and the fourpence is mine.
